pairs.subject: edge-queue-policy
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:51 Context and repository searches found no standing signal edge here: messages use fetched snapshots, queue references concern rendering or status display, and backpressure/drop-oldest appeared only in unrelated repository documentation.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/review-voice.ts:82 The settings preview's notification bus invokes listeners directly; it does not admit lifecycle and data messages into a shared bounded channel.

src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:70 The message source selects mock or fetched thread snapshots, rather than receiving a standing signal whose queue deliberately drops messages.
src/components/dashboard/views/messages/index.tsx:75 The displayed message limit selects a page from retained data; it does not evict classes of traffic from a bounded channel.
src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:52 Cancellation suppresses a completed request's stale result; there is no queued continuing output requiring admission-time interruption.
src/components/dashboard/arrival/Deferred.tsx:24 The modal's arrival queue schedules a one-time mount callback, rather than selecting messages across continuing typed inputs.
src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:53 A completed fetch replaces the thread snapshot; no declared standing channel needs a per-edge depth or overflow policy.
